units.source_text: 匂亲王的游船在宇治川中往返上下。

en.t: Prince Niou's pleasure boat went up and down the Uji River.

units.source_text: 船中演奏美妙的音乐，山庄里也能听到。

en.t: Beautiful music was played on the boat, and it could be heard even at the villa.

units.source_text: 船中情状隐约可以望见，故山庄中的青年侍女都走出岸边来观看。

en.t: The scene aboard the boat could be faintly seen, so the young serving women from the villa all came out to the riverbank to watch.

units.source_text: 虽然不能看到匂亲王本人，但能望见这游船顶上装饰着红叶，像锦绣一般华丽。

en.t: Although they could not see Prince Niou himself, they could see the roof of the pleasure boat adorned with red maple leaves, splendid as brocade.

units.source_text: 声声奏出的音乐随风飘来，气势十分浩大。

en.t: The strains of music drifted over on the wind, with a truly magnificent force.

units.source_text: 世人对皇子奉承异常殷勤，连私人出游时也如此体面。

en.t: People showed extraordinary deference to a prince, so even a private outing was conducted with such dignity.

units.source_text: 众侍女望见了这盛况，想道：“真了不起啊！

en.t: Seeing this grand spectacle, the serving women thought, "How marvelous!

units.source_text: 即使一年只有七夕相逢一度，也要欢迎这光明的牵牛星。”

en.t: Even if we could meet only once a year on Tanabata, we would gladly welcome this radiant Altair."

units.source_text: 游览中准备赋诗，故有几位文章博士随驾同行。

en.t: Since poems were to be composed during the excursion, several scholars of letters accompanied the party.

units.source_text: 黄昏时分，停舟泊岸，一面奏乐，一面赋诗。

en.t: At dusk they moored the boat by the shore, playing music while composing poems.

units.source_text: 诸人头上插着颜色或深或淡的红叶，共奏《海仙乐》。

en.t: With maple leaves of various deep and pale colors tucked into their hair, they all performed "Kaisenraku" together.

units.source_text: 人人喜形于色，独有匂亲王怀着“何故人称近江海”的心情。

en.t: Everyone's face showed delight, but Prince Niou alone was filled with the feeling of the line, "Why do people call it the Sea of Omi?"

units.source_text: 他遥念山庄中的二女公子抱恨如何，对一切都心不在焉。

en.t: Thinking from afar how resentful the two young ladies at the villa must be, he paid no real attention to anything around him.

units.source_text: 诸人各出适合时地的题目，相与赋诗吟诵。

en.t: The others each proposed themes suited to the time and place, then composed and recited poems together.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想等待众人稍稍静息之时，赴山庄访问，并将此意告知匂亲王。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, wished to wait until everyone had quieted down a little before visiting the villa, and he told Prince Niou of this intention.

units.source_text: 正在此时，宰相中将的哥哥卫门督奉了明石皇后懿旨，带了一大批随从人员，威武堂皇地赶上来了。

en.t: Just then, the Gate Guards Captain, elder brother of the Consultant Captain, arrived in imposing state with a large retinue, carrying the command of Empress Akashi.

units.source_text: 原来皇子离都出游，即使是微行，消息也自会不胫而走，成为后世援例。

en.t: After all, when a prince left the capital on an outing, even incognito, the news would spread of its own accord and become a precedent for later times.

units.source_text: 何况匂亲王此次随从带得不多，突然启行。

en.t: Moreover, Prince Niou had set out suddenly this time with only a small number of attendants.

units.source_text: 明石皇后闻之大惊，因此吩咐卫门督带了大批殿上人赶来。

en.t: When Empress Akashi heard of it, she was greatly alarmed and ordered the Gate Guards Captain to hurry there with many courtiers.

units.source_text: 这形势实甚尴尬，匂皇子和薰中纳言都暗中叫苦，大家意兴索然。

en.t: The situation was extremely awkward; Prince Niou and Kaoru both groaned inwardly, and everyone's spirits were dampened.

units.source_text: 但不了解二人心事的人，管自飞觞醉月，乱舞高歌，直到东方既白。

en.t: But those who did not know what was in the two men's hearts went on passing cups, getting drunk under the moon, dancing wildly and singing loudly until the east grew light.
